rongmei.title: He jona le nang thao lana

lines: 1. He jona le nang thau lana
Ninevi kaidai thang tei din tad tho;
Lung lai mak ge thei nang kaidai
Ravguangc rui sumaan puni the,
Ravguangc hukhou rui duak khang pak tad na
Kha daimei bung lung khou
Ravguangc ruina riaplou the.
Ai rian ra the, he Poubaomei
Khabung lung khou hei nang ta kalum e
Ai rianra the , ai rian ra the.
Ata zian na thuak lou dat ro.
2. Nthuk mei khun khou ai bam e,
Aru khou thing nui rui gum liam ngam the;
Arian ra nthak khang numak
Zingbang ni kalaan ni thaimak
Aram rianra hei ai khang ngam lak khe,
Ata thuaklou datro, nang lat ai piu datni the.
3. Aravguangc nang ta ning tou na
Arasuai nang kai khou hei phung guang e,
Nang bang ta nzian lou datro
Nang ta thuanpui lu suan dat ni,
Thei mei khou rui duak khang
Aring bam kiu nang nade.
Compose by. Pastor Abui
